host.description: Fully qualified domain name for Hashtopolis, like 'hashtopolis.example.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.

public_url.title: Public URL
public_url.description: Base URL under which this instance is reachable from agents and browsers, like 'https://hashtopolis.example.org'. Leave empty to derive it from the host name and the Traefik settings of this node. Set it when the instance is published through a gateway node that terminates TLS while this node serves plain http.

ip_allowlist.title: Allowed client networks
ip_allowlist.description: CIDR networks allowed to reach the web UI and the agent API through this node's Traefik; empty allows all. A route on another node (e.g. the Internet entry node) needs its own allow-list.
